name: team.opay.offline.acquirer.mpos.ui.PosPaymentActivity
description: When OPay Offline Acquirer receives a Mini POS payment request, this Activity displays the payment screen and initializes the connected payment-terminal provider. It accepts an order from the app or an OPay payment link.
disableEffect: Users cannot pay through the OPay Mini POS flow, including payments that require the connected payment terminal.
